row: B19 S1: humans-only Team Space contract (handle invite, leave and removal, member projection, default channel, pilot admission)
providers: Atum platform company authority and Shell native routes

base.rule: v1 has no contract.json. Its wire is restated in this pack as v1.* types and messages, answered byte for byte as before whenever Atum-Company-Wire is absent

selection.probe: GET /api/matrix/v1/companies with the header: schemaVersion 2 means the server speaks 1.1, schemaVersion 1 means it does not

POST /api/matrix/v1/companies/{companyId.v1: 404 before authentication, as for any unknown action

errors.invite_target_unavailable: one status, body and header set for: handle not assigned, handle belongs to a non-person or an ineligible person, person already invited/active/revoking, person at their membership cap
errors.invite_lookup_limited: Retry-After seconds; answered for every handle once the admin's failure budget is spent
errors.company_creation_closed: create by a person the pilot admission does not allow
errors.last_admin: leave or remove would leave members without an active admin

identity_projection.member_ref: 32 random bytes, base64url (43 characters), stored per (company, principal) in a private table at first invitation and reused on readmission; stable across readmission, unlinkable to the principal, the Matrix ID or another company without database access, with no key to manage or rotate
identity_projection.principal_on_1_1_wire: never, in any request or response of this pack
identity_projection.principal_on_1_wire: unchanged: members[].principal, channel memberPrincipals and project memberPrincipals, to the audiences that receive them today
identity_projection.principal_elsewhere: public-handles lookup answers the holder's principal for an assigned handle; a Matrix ID is visible to every member of a shared room. This pack claims neither is secret

audiences.active_member: active rows only; handle, displayName, avatarUri, role, self
audiences.admin: invited, active and revoking rows with the same fields; removed rows keep memberRef, role and state only; at most 100 member rows, live rows first, then the newest removed rows, so the row cap never hides a live person
audiences.invitee: the invitation and the inviter's handle and displayName while the inviter is an active member; nothing about other members

fields.handle: the current alias, or null; changes when the person renames
fields.displayName: the person's Matrix profile name, or null; text only
fields.avatarUri: the person's Matrix profile avatar mxc URI, present only when one is set

order: caller is an active admin of the company, else 403 as in v1
replay lookup by actor and requestId
resolve the current assignment of the handle
bind the request to the resolved person and insert the invitation
invite.eligibility: an active human on the company's issuer who is not invited, active or revoking in this company and is under their own membership cap; a removed person is eligible (readmission)
invite.refusal: every failure after grammar is one 404 invite_target_unavailable and counts against the admin's failure budget; successes do not
invite.binding: a successful request stores operation, company, role, the normalized handle and the first resolved person
invite.replay: same requestId, same normalized handle and role: answered from the stored person, never re-resolved; a different handle or role: 409; a request that failed resolution stores nothing
invite.normalization: a leading @ is dropped and letters fold to lower case

admission.public_requires: the account-deletion service entry of the revocation core is live (S7)
admission.replay: a replayed create that already succeeded is answered; admission is not re-evaluated

default_channel.seeded_by: create, in its transaction, for both wires
default_channel.idempotency: a replayed create returns the same company and the same defaultChannelId; at most one default channel per company
default_channel.archive: an ordinary channel; archive and restore apply with no special refusal

revocation.authority_ends: in the transaction that records revoking
revocation.removed_after: the room manager has witnessed the ban in every registered channel room (atum.company-channel-rooms/1 bannedHumanPrincipals); a person in no room is removed in the same operation
revocation.retire: the last active member leaving retires the company: invitations withdrawn, channels archived, caps released, never reactivated
revocation.replay: a leave replay is answered from the stored request of the same actor and requestId even after the actor has stopped being a member; every other replay re-authorizes the actor first
revocation.self_removal: remove-member naming the caller's own memberRef is 400; leave is the only self path
revocation.readmission: a fresh invitation to a removed person, same membership row and memberRef, same channel rooms, no project grant restored

platform_internal.from: company authority entry point or account-deletion service
platform_internal.to: the revocation core (a database function; no route)
